    • isEarlyDataAccepted

      boolean isEarlyDataAccepted()
      Determines whether early data is accepted by the server. This method is called when the client has indicated it wants to use early data and the TLS layer of the server can accept it; this callback is used to let the server (that uses this library) decide whether it will accept early data.
